column1: # Curated identifiers for license files bundling more than one license.
# Add a row only after reading the vendored file yourself; joining with SPDX
# AND asserts both apply, and a slash would read as a choice between them.

column3: ships LICENSE (Apache-2.0) and LICENSE.libyaml (MIT, for the Go port of libyaml) as two files; go-licenses reports only the Apache-2.0 LICENSE
single LICENSE opening "This project is covered by two different licenses: MIT and Apache", with a full-text MIT section and an Apache-2.0 section; go-licenses reports only MIT
